bcl:section.bcl:marginalnote: Overtime wages for employees not working under an averaging agreement

bcl:subsection.bcl:text: An employer must pay an employee who works over 8 hours a day, and is not working under an averaging agreement under section 37,

bcl:paragraph.bcl:text: 1 1/2 times the employee's regular wage for the time over 8 hours, and
double the employee's regular wage for any time over 12 hours.

bcl:subsection.bcl:text: An employer must pay an employee who works over 40 hours a week, and is not working under an averaging agreement under section 37, 1 1/2 times the employee's regular wage for the time over 40 hours.

For the purpose of calculating weekly overtime under subsection (2), only the first 8 hours worked by an employee in each day are counted, no matter how long the employee works on any day of the week.
